(cover page only; no chiller body text in available document); (2) Roof Fall Protection Design Analysis — identification of all locations requiring fall protection along Building 1 and Building 6 roof areas, totaling approximately 7,300 LF of required railing, with structural analysis and railing system recommendations.
scope_summary.source: Design Analysis cover page (p.1); Roof Fall Protection Analysis body text
scope_summary.quote: The scope of this project is to identify all locations along the Building 1 and Building 6 Roof areas where fall protection is required. The study is intended to identify locations, quantities, and types of fall protection required for complete railing installation across the entire scope area, as well as provide a general fall protection construction document sheet for provision to and Designers or Contractors who will be performing design or construction work near fall risk areas in the scope location.

sheets.title: Roof Fall Protection Design Analysis — Cover Page with Aerial Photo
sheets.reading_notes: Second document cover page. Title: ROOF FALL PROTECTION / PROJECT # 688-22-004 / VAMC, Washington DC. Aerial photo shows the VAMC Washington DC campus — large multi-wing hospital complex with extensive flat roofing. Buildings are multi-story. Final dated 3/03/2025. SDVOSB Company noted.

sheets.title: Fall Protection Design Analysis — General, Scope, Background, Design Criteria
sheets.reading_notes: Scope of work text: identifies fall protection locations on Building 1 and Building 6 roof areas. Background: IBC Section 1015 guardrail requirements. Design criteria: IBC 2024, OSHA 1926/29 CFR, VA TIL, ASCE 7-22. No square footage or floor count stated.

sheets.title: Layout of Fall Protection — Roof Plan Diagram
sheets.reading_notes: Plan diagram of VAMC roof showing Building 1 and Building 6 fall protection extents (dashed red line indicates required railing locations). Complex multi-wing roof plan. Crane staging areas marked at two locations. Numbered railing segments visible (approximately 15+ distinct numbered zones). No scale bar or dimensions shown at this rendered resolution. The roof plan suggests a large, irregular hospital complex.

sheets.reading_notes: Site photos showing existing ballasted roof conditions with orange traffic cones at roof edges (inadequate fall protection). Confirms ballast roof type with large gravel/aggregate. Shows multi-story building height. B1 mechanical core visible in background.
